required_fields.subject: Some advanced smart meters
required_fields.first: track the electricity use of individual devices
required_fields.second: allow the utility or customer to control electricity use remotely

cq1-a26.projected_text: Some advanced smart meters can track the electricity use of individual devices and allow the utility or customer to control electricity use remotely.
cq1-a26.archived_power_or_capability_prose_retai: The EIA describes advanced smart meters as capable of tracking the electricity use of individual devices.

required_fields.conditions: you use a 40-Watt (0.04 kW) light bulb for five hours

cq1-a10.projected_text: For example, if you use a 40-Watt (0.04 kW) light bulb for five hours, you have used 200 Wh.
cq1-a10.archived_power_or_capability_prose_retai: The source light-bulb example uses 200 Wh of electrical energy.
